entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: Forest at the heart of the Gilt-Leaf elves' realm in Lorwyn, considered by elves the most beautiful.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf tribe
entities.description: Elven tribe whose realm contains the wood.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: Capital of the Gilt-Leaf realm, within the wood.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: Shaman of the Perfect caste said to have created the wood.

events.summary: By legend, Eidren orders hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
events.quote: Eidren ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful.

relations.quote: Legend says that the Gilt-Leaf Wood was created by Eidren
The capital of the Gilt-Leaf realm, Lys Alana , lay within.
